league_primary: per target: mean per-observation loss (Bernoulli NLL for shares, NB NLL for rates) of the chosen tracker minus the win5+div reference on 2024-25, card-cluster bootstrap CI; expected: stat-level targets (slpm, sapm, tdpm, ctrlpm, subpm, kd100, r108) < 0, outcome-mix targets ~0. A target whose CI excludes 0 on the wrong side is 'contradicted' and its deployment falls back to the win5+div reference.
league_secondary: base-rate table for 2024 and 2025 (mean one-step-ahead prediction vs realised); the +brk variants (glove / ABC 2024-25 breaks as variance interventions) vs the chosen config, descriptive only

method.production: unchanged (static S2 + ML v2 winner): the nested forward-chained gate 2021-2023 failed on both 7-bin and joint

desc_text.M1_cv_final: the CV-final configuration (chosen on 2016-2023; fin / ko 'none' by the 0.0005 rule, r1 Kalman)
desc_text.M2_fast_dec: decision-vs-finish EW tracker that the nested gate picked in 2022 and 2023 (fin: ew h=0.25 y, n0=200, rho=0, + division n0s=200), alone

method.metrics: 7-bin, method3, finish (decision vs finish), joint, round given finish; decision-share calibration-in-the-large for 2024 and 2025 (mean predicted vs realised)
method.expectation: M1 joint within +-0.002 (CV -0.0008, gate years +0.0005); M2 finish loss lower only if the 2024-25 decision drift persists within the window (the tracker lags by ~3 months); none of them changes production

stat.rule: statlines' rule on CV 2021-2023: pooled gain > 0.001 nats per fight-side and better in >= 2 of 3 years
stat.primary: per adopted stat: NLL per fight-side (adjusted - static) on the 2024-25 'valid' rows, date-cluster bootstrap CI. Confirmed if the point is < 0; contradicted (adjustment withdrawn) if the CI lies entirely above 0
stat.secondary: sig-landed deviance (unchanged by construction: sig_lnd is not adjusted), the non-adopted stats' best trackers (descriptive), level ratios realised / predicted by year
